Welcome to Shoreline Leisure

Your community hub for health, fitness, and well-being

At Shoreline Leisure, we believe fitness is for everyone. Our award-winning centres provide a welcoming space where you can enjoy a wide range of activities, connect with others, and focus on your overall well-being — body and mind. We’re proud recipients of the National Quality Standard Award, reflecting our commitment to excellence, top-class facilities, and friendly, qualified staff who are here to support you every step of the way.

With three locations —

we offer something for everyone:

Shoreline Leisure Bray
Shoreline Leisure Greystones
Shoreline Leisure Sportspark

EXPLORE OUR SERVICES

  • GYM

    Train in our fully equipped, friendly gyms at Shoreline Leisure Bray and Greystones. With expert staff and top-class equipment, we make it easy to reach your fitness goals in a welcoming, supportive environment.

    Location:Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Greystones

  • FITNESS CLASSES

    From high-energy workouts to relaxing mind-body sessions, our fitness classes suit every level. Join our supportive instructors and enjoy training that’s fun, social, and motivating.

    Location:Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Greystones , Shoreline Sportspark (outdoors)

  • FITNESS ASSESSMENTS

    Get expert guidance with our fitness assessments. Our qualified staff help you understand your current fitness, set realistic goals, and create a personalised plan to achieve results.

    Location:Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Greystones

  • SWIMMING POOL

    Dive into our heated pools at Shoreline Leisure Bray and Greystones. Enjoy lane swimming, family fun, and expert swimming lessons in a safe, welcoming environment for all ages and abilities.

    Location:Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Greystones

  • SWIM SCHOOL

    Our swim schools offers lessons for all ages and abilities, helping you or your child gain confidence, skills, and water safety in a friendly environment.

    Location:Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Greystones

  • PADEL COURTS

    Play, improve, and have fun on our modern padel courts. Perfect for beginners and seasoned players, with booking options available.

    Location: Shoreline Sportspark

    Information

  • RUNNING TRACK

    Stay active on our fully accessible running track, perfect for jogging, sprinting, or walking at your own pace in a safe, open environment.

    Location: Shoreline Sportspark

    Information

  • SKATE PARK

    Enjoy our safe, inclusive skate park — ideal for beginners and experienced skaters to practice, play, and socialise outdoors.

    Location: Shoreline Sportspark

    Information

  • OUTDOOR FACILITES

    Make the most of our versatile outdoor spaces, from sports pitches to recreational areas, for fun, fitness, and community activities.

    Location: Shoreline Sportspark

  • SPORTS HALL

    Our versatile sports hall hosts a range of indoor sports and activities for all ages and abilities, providing a safe and welcoming space to play and compete.

    Location:Shoreline Greystones

    Information

  • KIDS CAMPS

    Our fun and engaging kids camps keep children active, learning, and socialising in a safe, friendly environment. Activities cater to all ages and abilities.

    Location:Shoreline Sportspark & Shoreline Bray

  • ASTRO PITCHES

    Our high-quality astro pitches are perfect for football and team sports. Enjoy a safe, all-weather surface for training, matches, and recreational play.

    Location: Shoreline Bray & Shoreline Sportspark

READY TO JOIN SHORELINE LEISURE

  • YEARLY MEMBERSHIP

    Enjoy unlimited access to Shoreline Leisure’s facilities with our annual membership. Stay active, try different activities, and make the most of our gyms, pools, classes, and more all year round.

    We have a range of yearly options to suit all.

    LEARN MORE

  • MONTHLY RCP MEMBERSHIP

    Stay active and flexible with our monthly reoccurring card payment membership. Enjoy full access to Shoreline Leisure’s gyms, pools, classes, and facilities with the freedom of a month to month plan.

    We have a range of monthly options to suit all.

    LEARN MORE

  • PAYG OPTIONS

    Enjoy Shoreline Leisure’s facilities on your schedule with Pay As You Go. Perfect for casual visits, you can access our pools, outdoor facilities, sports hall, padel courts and much more.

    Visit your location to find out more PAYG options
